chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad, who said:

I asked him about a menstruating woman who breaks her sawm (fast) in the month of Ramadan during the days of her menstruation, and then, after breaking the fast, she dies. He said: “There is nothing upon her.”

key_terms.تُفْطِرُ: she breaks or leaves the fast
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the obligatory period of sawm (fasting)
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا شَيْءٌ: nothing is due upon her; there is no remaining liability

ai.seo_question: If a menstruating woman misses Ramadan fasts and dies before making them up, is anything due from her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman who leaves sawm (fasting) in Ramadan due to menstruation and then dies before making it up. The Imam عليه السلام states that no obligation remains upon her, indicating that no liability is due in such a case.
